content:
Indian Air Force (Bhartiya Vayu Sena) has released the Exam City Details for the recruitment of Group ‘Y’ Medical Assistant Airmen Trade Intake 02/2027.

The examination is scheduled for 22–23 September 2026. The online application window opened on 06 July 2026 and closed on 26 July 2026. The exam city details are available from 11 September 2026, while admit cards are released 24–48 hours before the exam date.

Important Dates

  • Online Apply Start Date: 06 July 2026
  • Online Apply Last Date: 26 July 2026
  • Last Date for Fee Payment: 26 July 2026
  • Correction Date: 05 – 07 August 2026
  • Exam Date: 22 – 23 September 2026
  • Exam City Details: 11 September 2026 Available Now
  • Admit Card: 24-48 Hours Before the Exam Date
  • Result Date: Will Be Updated Here Soon

Indian Air Force medical assistant eligibility requires a 10+2 / Intermediate with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, English and a minimum 50% aggregate including English, or a Diploma / B.Sc in Pharmacy with the specified criteria and registration from the State Pharmacy Council or PCI.

The selection process includes a Proficiency Test, English Written Test, Physical Fitness Test I & II, Adaptability Test – II and medical appointments.
